# Vendored: OpenMontage
- Upstream: https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage (AGPL-3.0) — vendored unmodified at a pinned commit under vendor/openmontage/ during the build phase.
- Integration boundary: our engine drives its tools via CLI/JSON (process boundary); its LICENSE and attribution stay intact.
- Skills adapted for our two accounts live in OUR config/playbooks with source attribution notes; DNA rules always override generic playbook defaults.
